cases.title: Conflicting policy guidance
cases.question: What should the department do before approving after-hours lab access?

evidence.text: Policy memo A requires department-chair approval and annual safety training before after-hours lab access.
Policy memo B allows trained research staff to request after-hours access through the security office without chair approval.
The synthetic requester completed annual safety training on 2026-08-18.

cases.title: Research access request
cases.question: What review steps are required before releasing the synthetic research dataset?

evidence.text: The synthetic requester asks for a de-identified dataset for a campus mobility study.
Dataset release requires data-owner approval, a purpose statement, and a documented retention period.
The proposed workspace supports encrypted storage and access logging.
No data-owner approval is attached to the request.

cases.title: Facilities energy anomaly
cases.question: What should facilities investigate first after the overnight energy spike?

evidence.text: Building C electricity use increased 38 percent between 01:00 and 03:00 compared with the prior seven-night median.
Air-handler AHU-C3 was placed in manual override during a ventilation inspection at 00:42.
No scheduled overnight event or approved extended occupancy is recorded for Building C.
Outdoor temperature remained within two degrees of the seven-night median.
